cases.sentence: Подошли ___, завернули его тело, вынесли и похоронили.
cases.explain: «молодые люди» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

cases.sentence: ___ вошли и, найдя ее мертвой, вынесли и похоронили ее рядом с мужем.
cases.explain: «Молодые люди» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

cases.sentence: Всей церковью и всеми, кто об этом слышал, овладел ___.
cases.explain: «великий страх» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

cases.sentence: И никто из ___ не решался к ним присоединяться, хотя народ их очень уважал.
cases.explain: «случайных людей» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.

cases.sentence: Они приносили больных и одержимых ___, и все исцелялись.
cases.explain: «нечистыми духами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.

cases.sentence: — ___ надежно закрыты, у ворот стоит охрана, но когда мы вошли внутрь, мы никого там не нашли.
cases.explain: «Тюремные ворота» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

cases.explain: «другие апостолы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

cases.sentence: Поэтому в ___ вот вам мой совет: оставьте этих людей.
cases.explain: «данном случае» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
